fire_demon.name: Volatile
fire_demon.ability:
When a Fire Demon rolls a natural 6 or 7, the ball ignites — roll again: on 5–12 add it (surge), on 1–4 subtract it (backfire).
In a skill test, a surge that wins resolves your maneuver as its advanced version; a backfire that loses resolves your opponent's maneuver as its advanced version.
fire_demon.ability_short: Natural 6–7: ignite. Roll again — 5–12 add (surge), 1–4 subtract (backfire). In a skill test: a surge that wins upgrades your maneuver to advanced; a backfire that loses upgrades your opponent's.

cyborg.name: Lithium Powered
cyborg.ability:
Your exhaustion tokens are drain. You are Drained (treated as Exhausted) at 7 drain. 
Overdrive: before any dice roll can gain 3 drain tokens to add +5. 
Charge-up: remove one token if cyborg doesn't move during run back.
cyborg.ability_short: Exhaustion = drain. 3 drain → +5 before a roll. Drained at 7. −1 drain for holding still on a run back.

telekinetic.name: Mind Pull
telekinetic.ability:
Mind pull: When your team doesn't have possession and the ball moves to or through your space, you may take 1 exhaustion and roll a d12 — on 11–12 you pull it in and take possession.
Smooth: When your team has possession and the ball moves to or through your space, you may take it over instead.
telekinetic.ability_short: Ball passes you: take 1 exhaustion, roll d12; 11–12 = you take the ball. Smooth: your own ball moves to or through you — take it over free.

ooze.name: Slimey
ooze.ability:
Merge: an Ooze on the ball's space who isn't one of the two players rolling adds their skill to their own side in skill tests and contests — oSkill attacking, dSkill defending. Every such Ooze adds.
Spreadable: Ooze  counts as 0 toward its  space's occupancy, and is never made to run back in order to break up a stack.
ooze.ability_short: A non-rolling Ooze on the ball adds oSkill (attack) or dSkill (defence) to tests & contests. Ooze counts as 0 toward space occupancy.
